body:
Its sold as an aphrodisiac or male potency powder.  Turns out however that this is an amazing party drug.  Bought in Australia in powdered form.
I drank 2 grams mixed into a cup of toasted yerba mate as it is commonly used together in herbal preperations.
Effects started after 15 mins mildly.  Felt the stimulant properties of the Mate first.  After about 1 hour the catuaba was coming on.  I went to bathroom and noticed pupil dilation of about half of what I would get from ecstasy.  The coming up effect was very similar to mda.  After 2 hours the peak was very nice.  Some drum and bass music send chills all over my body and I wanted to dance like crazy.  This stuff works.  Felt very elated and happy, not quite as talkative or loved up as e and not as speedy as e either, BUT effects were strong all the same with no unpleasant sweating or heart racing like can be with e. Felt 'mashed up', that lovely messed up kinda fucked feeling that e gives, also great concentration and focus.  Very social.  Can only imagine what 5-10 grams is like.
Combined with a few other things like Mate, Muira Puama, or other stimulant and maybe I've finally found the perfect safe e substitute!
Effects lasted for several hours with very gradual totally unnoticeable comedown.  A feeling of aliveness and happyness lasts and lasts.  Awesome.
